standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the pullback of the diagonal along a test morphism as an isomorphism space

standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the monomorphism condition into a condition on the fibres of the diagonal.

core_obligations: Conditions (2) and (3) are the same condition: the diagonal of any morphism of stacks is representable by algebraic spaces, so being a monomorphism as a morphism of algebraic spaces is the same as the corresponding condition stated in (3) (proof lines 418-435)

(1) is equivalent to (2): the pullback of the diagonal along a test morphism is the isomorphism space of the pair of objects with the prescribed identification, so the diagonal being a monomorphism is exactly the requirement that this space be a subsheaf of the test object, which is condition (1) (proof lines 436-448)
proof_roadmap: Δ_f 恒可表示为代数空间的空间 ⇒ (2) 与 (3) 所说的单态射是同一件事。
把 Δ_f 沿测试态射拉回得到同构空间 Isom(x_1, x_2)；(1) 正是说该空间到测试对象的映射是单态射（即至多一个截面） ⇒ 与 (2) 等价。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three equivalent formulations of the representability condition on the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic stacks (author lemma at source lines 404-416, label lemma-properties-diagonal-representable). The proof (source lines 418-449) notes that the diagonal is always representable by algebraic spaces so that two of the formulations coincide, and identifies the pullback of the diagonal along a test morphism with an isomorphism space, which turns the monomorphism condition into the corresponding condition on that space (proof lines 418-448). The identification of the pullback with the isomorphism space is the substance. H3.
